label: AIVD 3.60 REPRESENTATION-GAP AUDIT
what_it_is: A boolean log event and an unread flag. Not a stored number.

formula.quote: c.secret or (c.security_shaped and not c.greedy_metric) or (c.metric_delta >= 0.08 and c.error and not c.greedy_metric)
formula.gate: that boolean, AND not c.secret, AND used_ops is non-empty, AND allow_intra
formula.dead_disjunct: c.secret cannot open this gate, because the gate also requires not c.secret
formula.security_shaped: secret or error_appeared or (error and metric >= 0.2)
formula.greedy_metric: metric >= 0.55 and not secret and not error_appeared
inputs: metric delta versus the baseline observation

history.comment: token-level residual without secret; current grammar may not preserve identity

sites: observe: the residual gate logs the event, then calls invent() and maybe _maybe_declare_gap()
invent: logs a different why-string when hot indices exist and no intra-token method is compiled yet
_maybe_declare_gap: sets the flag and does not log this event name

consumers.the_branch: calls _mark_hot_from_ops, invent(), and _maybe_declare_gap(). Those can add methods. They do not rank atom candidates.
consumers.growth: not an input to language growth or compose admission
consumers.retirement: retirement uses the lease boolean, which is computed earlier
consumers.secret: the gate requires secret to be false

usefulness.meaning: the else branch of secret on an atom promote. Stored as the promote reason. Not a formula over outputs.

program_1.meaning: The residual gate was false. This mode logs the event when the gate is true, and other events were logged, so this is not a silent true.

program_2.meaning: The residual gate was true. invent() added no method, because the next log line is not invent. The program had already been retired by the lease path.

hypotheses.H27a: SUPPORTED as an observation-side boolean. It is not a stored numeric quality score.
hypotheses.H27b: NOT_SUPPORTED. The gate does not read program outputs.
hypotheses.H27c: PARTIAL. The same branch can call invent(). It does not rank candidates. On the second 3.54 program that call added nothing.
hypotheses.H27d: NOT_SUPPORTED as purely diagnostic. The flag is unread, but the branch calls invent().
hypotheses.H27e: SUPPORTED. Usefulness is the else of secret. The gap also requires the residual boolean. Either can occur without the other.
hypotheses.H27f: NOT_SUPPORTED. The gate requires secret to be false.
hypotheses.H27g: SUPPORTED. The comment says residual-without-secret. A definition of representation quality is NOT_RECORDED.
hypotheses.H27-REJECT: NOT the result. The gate is in the source.

unresolved: why security_shaped uses 0.2 and greedy uses 0.55
the metric and error on either compose observation
a definition of representation quality beyond the code comment
limitation: A logged gap is an observation-side gate. It is not evidence the program differed from its components, and a missing log is not evidence that it did not.
